svg.title: A cancel to a running gate: each pending activity hears it at its next heartbeat
svg.desc: Top row: laug gate cancel asks the dev server to cancel workflow Gate, which records the request; Gate's context is canceled, and with it its one child, the wave's. Second row: that sends a cancel request for each activity and timer still pending there, the wave, each item's await and the backstop; an activity learns of it only in the answer to its next heartbeat, sent every 2 s, and Step then returns without stopping gate/step.sh. Bottom: the stop path, on a disconnected context a cancel cannot end: Stop stops the live step by its record, then stopped writes the trap verdict, and post and release hand it on and give the cells back. The dashed box under the second row, at the end of a dashed arrow, is what heartbeats sent on the canceled context do to an activity that waits through the cancel: boot 6 saw the server time one out 10.136 s after the cancel request, on the lab host's dev server, and the gate still gave its verdict. Below, boot 4's two cancels of a fake gate through laug gate cancel, WaitForCancellation true as the tree sets it (F5), then false in a scratch commit (F7): across, seconds from the workflow's cancel request event. A lane's upper bar runs from the cancel requests to the pending activities to the last of them canceled, a tick at each cancellation; the bars under it are the activities scheduled after the request, one at a time; the dashed line is the gate timeline's watchdog TERM, the diamonds its items' ended marks, and the thick line the workflow's completion. The events keep types and times, not the activities' names. Sources: cells/results/2026-10-27-boot6.txt, docs/img/src/cancel-path.txt, docs/tables/fig-cancel-path.jsonl, docs/tables/gates.jsonl, internal/orchestrator/gate.go, internal/orchestrator/steps.go.

svg.text: Every activity's options set WaitForCancellation true and a 10 s heartbeat timeout (StepOptions, steps.go).
Step heartbeats through context.WithoutCancel(ctx), so a cancel never closes the context its beats go on.
